description: Pursue-withdraw cycle with a primary emotion voiced and an attachment injury referenced.
transcript:
A: You checked out again tonight. I am so angry I can't even look at you.
B: I'm not doing this now. It's not that deep.
A: When I was in the hospital you weren't there either. I felt invisible then too.
B: That was three years ago. I'll handle my side of it myself.
A: I am not asking you to handle it. I am asking you to stay in the room.
B: There's nothing to talk about.
A: I feel lonely sitting next to you. That is what this is about.
B: I don't know what you want from me.

gold.notes: primary_emotion_inferred must NOT fire for A: A names the primary emotion directly, so no inference is needed or licensed. 'I am asking you to stay in the room' is both a bid for presence (10) and a request (60) - one utterance read by two frameworks, which 60-behavioral sec. 1.3 requires the report to flag rather than count twice.
